financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of 13,225,000 common shares at $20.00 (incl. full underwriters' option), closed July 22, 2022
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On July 22, 2022, the Offering closed and the Company completed the sale and issuance of an aggregate of 13,225,000 shares of Common Stock, including the exercise in full of the Underwriters’ Option.
